mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening consumer demand and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is above its 10-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated consumer spending.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) in a late-cycle expansion regime signals sustained manufacturing activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales growth rate exceeding 0.5% (RSAFS MoM) indicates strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS MoM growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index values above 250 indicate elevated inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through a positive demand feedback loop.
failure_condition: The joint strength of HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates (UNRATE below 4.0%) during high labor market tightness regimes indicate strong wage growth and consumer spending, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.
